name: @sand/devices
description: Your devices: add and pair other PCs, pair phones and browsers, and reach sand away from home

sand.label: Your devices
sand.summary: Add another PC with one command or a pairing link, pair a phone with a QR code, and remove paired devices

uses.commands: opens the pair dialog from a Devices button in the sidebar instead of /devices
uses.nav: no sidebar button when there is no /devices command
uses.notify: no message when a device pairs or a request fails
uses.picker: no Rename on phones and browsers
